newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset sees five pct rise in 1997 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset sees five pct rise in 1997 turnover.

text.p: Italian broadcasting group Mediaset expects to achieve an increase in 1997 turnover of possibly more than five percent, boosted by rising advertising revenue, managing director Ubaldo Livolsi said on Thursday.
"This year the market is growing strongly and for 1997 we have budgeted for nominal growth of over five percent for the whole year and of 2.5 percent in real terms," said Livolsi in an interview.
